about: Whiteboard house look (fixed: one house look per style, new components every reel).
layout: frame 1 = the speaker's face full screen + the hook pill; the white board drops over the top half (0-960) on the first words, the face slides into the bottom half (pivot and scale from face.json, the whole face under the seam)

type.board: Caveat 700 handwriting, revealed left to right while the marker writes it
type.captions: white Inter 750 pills on the seam (y 914), the spoken word swept in yellow #FFE14D

strokes: seeded rough geometry (board.py helpers), drawn on with stroke-dashoffset, never popped; a visible marker follows every stroke and word, lifts off between ideas; an eraser wipe between pages
cover: the board goes full screen only over a look-away (build/cover_windows.json), <= 2.5 s
film: the speaker's face as shot: no grade, no filter
sound: a quiet bed ducked under the voice; marker scribble as texture (>= 1.6 s apart), an eraser whoosh per page
vary_per_reel: the drawings and the page metaphors (new every reel: components.py plan --style whiteboard)
grade_rule: none: the speaker's footage stays as shot; the board has no inserts
components_rule: the house look is the type, captions, accents and the speaker's face as shot; the drawings, page metaphors, hook and outro pages are NEW every reel (scripts/components.py plan / check / record, catalog.json; each draw() names its shape)
